navigator_advisories_note: G3c: the generic degenerate checks of the navigator map (the view model is built in the browser, so the kernel's view engine cannot evaluate it): the same codes and the same loom.advisory/1 shape as the kernel's (nothing_visible, marks_identical). All presets, any value works: min_elements = how many marks a channel needs before 'all identical' is said (0 or 1 = even a single mark; a huge number = never); invisible_at_or_below per channel (absent = the channel cannot vanish); channels = which channels of a mark are checked and which data they show (words for the sentence). The fingerprint is the declaration id + channel (the mapping is the configuration, not the data), so 'don't ask' holds for this mapping on any level. Reverse: delete a channel here = it is no longer checked.

nothing_visible.en: Nothing is visible on the channel '{channel}': {invisible} of {total} marks are at or below {threshold} (it shows: {shows}).
nothing_visible.pl: Na kanale '{channel}' nic nie widać: {invisible} z {total} znaczników ma wartość nie większą niż {threshold} (pokazuje: {shows}).

marks_identical.en: All {total} marks get the same value {value} on the channel '{channel}', so it tells them apart by nothing (it shows: {shows}).
marks_identical.pl: Wszystkie {total} znaczniki mają na kanale '{channel}' tę samą wartość {value}, więc niczym ich nie rozróżnia (pokazuje: {shows}).
